name: Plymouth House of Pizza and Pub
tagline: Pizza and pub food with authentic Greek flavors, serving Plymouth, Massachusetts since 1997.
seo_title: Plymouth House of Pizza and Pub | Pizza & Greek Flavors in Plymouth, MA
seo_desc: Plymouth House of Pizza and Pub, 50 Long Pond Rd, Plymouth MA. Pizza with authentic Greek flavors, serving Plymouth since 1997. Call (508) 746-0444 or order online.
about: Plymouth House of Pizza and Pub is a pizzeria and pub at 50 Long Pond Rd, serving the town of Plymouth, Massachusetts since 1997.
The kitchen is known for authentic Greek flavors alongside pizza. See the full menu and place a pickup order on the shop's online ordering page, or call the shop.
menu_note: The shop's menu with prices lives on its online ordering page. Open it there, or call to ask about today's items.
findings: Built on the GoDaddy Website Builder with a stock layout.
The shop name and "Authentic Greek Flavors" headline repeat over and over in the page copy; the new copy says each once.
Phone number shown unformatted as 5087460444; now (508) 746-0444 with a tap-to-call link.
Homepage leads with a notice about dropping in-house delivery instead of the food; the new site leads with the food and ordering, and makes no delivery claim.
Stray punctuation error in the copy ("Plymouth,. Massachusetts since 1997"); fixed.
Ordering link (SkyTab) taken from the lead file; not tested by placing an order.
The shop's website could not be fetched while building (fetch was blocked), so menu, prices and hours were NOT collected; only facts from the lead file are used.
